name: Elizabeth House
paymentStructure: £5,000 reservation fee, followed by a 10% deposit. The remaining balance is due on completion.
headline: Modern urban living in London's commuter belt
description: Elizabeth House is a thoughtfully designed residential scheme in the heart of Staines-upon-Thames. A part-conversion, part-new build, the project converts a purpose-built office block into a stylish and contemporary apartment building, complete with two newly constructed floors. Once completed it will offer 34 self-contained apartments — 10 one-bedroom, 23 two-bedroom and 1 three-bedroom — arranged over five storeys and accessible via a newly extended passenger lift, a short walk from Staines Station and the River Thames.
highlightedFeatures: Part-conversion, part-new build with two additional floors
54 allocated parking spaces — a ratio exceeding 1:1 per unit
Energy-efficient electric heating and air source hot water system
developmentAmenities: Allocated private parking (available to purchase for every unit)

specification.heading: Decoration
items: White emulsion walls with selected art décor features
LED spot lighting throughout all rooms

specification.heading: Kitchen
items: Grey handleless kitchen units with push-to-open

specification.heading: Bathrooms
items: Calcutta ceramic wall tiles in bathrooms
High-efficiency ventilation systems in wet rooms (kitchen & bathroom)

specification.heading: Safety/Security
items: Safe escape routes per UK fire safety standards
Modern UPVC double-glazed windows with secure locks

locationNotes: Nestled in the heart of Staines-upon-Thames on London Road, linking to the town centre, Staines Station and the River Thames. Within 0.4 miles of Staines Station (direct trains to London Waterloo in approx. 35 minutes), 0.6 miles of Elmsleigh & Two Rivers shopping centres, and 0.7 miles from the River Thames. Quick access to the M25 (Junction 13), A30 and A308. Heathrow Airport is 4.6 miles away (around 12 minutes by car).
